draft_rule.justification: pitfall PITFALL-COO-003 encountered 5 times (threshold 5): git add -A 误 stage 子仓旧指针（worktree 共享环境）

evidence.prevention: 永远 git add <具体路径> 替代 -A；add 前自检 git diff --cached --submodule=short
evidence.symptom: add -A 后 commit 含 projects/<sub> gitlink 指向 side-branch/旧 checkout；被 submodule-guard/pointer-drift/gitlink-ancestry 任一 gate 以 "指针回退 NOT on origin/main" 拦截
